projects.title: AI Native TRPG Platform
projects.description: An AI-native TRPG platform that provides AI-driven TRPG gaming experiences.
projects.overview: This AI Native TRPG Platform represents a cutting-edge TRPG experience where creators can easily build, customize, and share their own TRPG games with deep AI technology integration.

projects.title: Rust/Python Microservices API
projects.description: High-performance microservices architecture built with Rust Axum and Python FastAPI.
projects.overview: This microservices cluster integrates Rust's high-performance advantages with Python's flexibility, providing complete solutions for user authentication, authorization, and resource management.

projects.title: ROS2-based Intelligent Autonomous Vehicle
projects.description: A comprehensive autonomous vehicle system built on ROS2 framework.
projects.overview: This intelligent autonomous vehicle system represents a complete implementation of self-driving technology using the ROS2 framework with advanced perception, decision-making, and execution modules.

projects.title: Product Preview 3D Reconstruction
projects.description: An automated 3D model generation application from product images.
projects.overview: This innovative application automates the process of generating 3D models from product images or videos, providing e-commerce businesses with enhanced product visualization capabilities.

projects.title: Computer Vision Target Tracking System
projects.description: Real-time target tracking system with YOLOv5 and PID control.
projects.overview: This computer vision target tracking system was developed as part of RoboCon competition research, focusing on real-time target detection and tracking in complex environments.

projects.title: LQR Control System for Inverted Pendulum
projects.description: Control system design using Luenberger observer and LQR algorithms.
projects.overview: This project focuses on designing and implementing an advanced control system for a single inverted pendulum using Luenberger observer for state estimation and Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) for optimal control.
